cluster: Risk phenomenon vs risk information artifact
conflict_or_distinction: Operational sources often use one row/label to stand for risk; foundational/comparator evidence separates real-world risk-relevant phenomena from descriptions/records
decision_rationale: Do not equate Risk with Risk Register Entry or Scenario Description; strongest cross-source operational-semantic distinction

cluster: Scenario / possible event vs realized event
conflict_or_distinction: Scenario labels and causal narratives can denote information objects, event types or possible events; realized incidents are occurrences
decision_rationale: Foundational prior art requires type/occurrence/information separation; scenario-description artifact remains distinct

source_evidence: SRC-OP-001 Jira schema; NIST 8286/RDR; RisKG; RiskHub
conflict_or_distinction: Record status/owner/fields are management-information semantics, not identity conditions of the underlying risk phenomenon
decision_rationale: Cross-source evidence consistently supports record/repository semantics; exact class identity deferred to W2

conflict_or_distinction: Operational fields encode values/results while literature/ontologies distinguish assessment processes from outputs
decision_rationale: Inherent/residual, likelihood and impact should be contextual results of assessment, not timeless Risk subclasses

conflict_or_distinction: Potential conflict between naming them as risks versus assessment states/results
decision_rationale: Avoid two separate enduring Risk entities until W2 proves otherwise; preserve source labels as mappings

source_evidence: SRC-OP-001 workflow values; NIST iterative lifecycle
conflict_or_distinction: Open/Analyzed/Treated/Closed and Completed/Reviewed/Ready describe record/process workflow; they do not necessarily describe whether the risk exists or its assessed severity
decision_rationale: Prevents closing a record from implying that a real-world risk ceased

source_evidence: SRC-OP-001 identifying/owning units; NIST risk owner; GRC model
conflict_or_distinction: Source values mix organizations, persons and responsibilities
decision_rationale: Risk Owner should be modeled as a context-dependent role/responsibility relation; concrete units stay external/profile data

source_evidence: SRC-PA-001-C012/C018; SRC-OP-001 response/treatment fields; ROSE; PA-006; Pharma PH-008
conflict_or_distinction: Sources overload mechanism, strategy, plan, activity and implemented control
decision_rationale: Do not collapse controlled vocabulary strategy, treatment plan, control mechanism and treatment activity into one class

conflict_or_distinction: Evidence object, observation event/result, data source and provenance relation are distinct despite operational overlap
decision_rationale: Needed for reassessment traceability and claim/evaluation provenance; OpenPVSignal confirms report/evidence prior art

conflict_or_distinction: Operational descriptions often imply causes while empirical sources may show association only
decision_rationale: Causal relation cannot be inferred from association/dependency; preserve epistemic limitation

conflict_or_distinction: Ordinal scale values are method-specific and should not become Core subclasses
decision_rationale: Core may own generic assessment-result semantics; actual 1–5 labels belong to methods/data

source_evidence: SRC-OP-001 taxonomy; SRC-PH-001 risk families; PH-009 categories
conflict_or_distinction: Strategic/financial/operational/Pharma categories vary by source and context
decision_rationale: Frequency/source taxonomy is not sufficient for Core class identity; preserve mappings and provenance

conflict_or_distinction: Risk meaning depends on goals/objects but business semantics have external owners
decision_rationale: SemRisk should reference goals/processes/capabilities without owning their complete enterprise taxonomy

conflict_or_distinction: Pharma entities are necessary context but are externally owned
decision_rationale: Map/federate to CM-PharmE; do not duplicate as SemRisk Core

conflict_or_distinction: Threat/opportunity are polarity/context values rather than separate universal Risk kinds by default
decision_rationale: Preserve positive/negative uncertainty without forcing subclassing
